Calibration of the differencing noise (sigma_epsilon)

Source: R/calibration_differencing.R
pm_calib_diff.Rd

Calibration of the differencing noise (sigma_epsilon)

Usage

pm_calib_diff(params = NULL, beta = NULL, tau = NULL, level = 0.95)

Arguments

params

object pm_params

beta

real vector of beta values (accuracy level of the inference)

tau

real vector of tau values (ceiling risk level)

level

confidence level for the confidence intervall of the relative loss

Value

data.frame and pm_calib_diff object

Details

By default, the function returns the results for some beta and tau values beta in (0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25) and tau in s(0.5, 0.55, 0.6, 0.65, ..., 0.90, 0.95)

Examples

# default behaviour
pm_calib_diff()
#>    beta  tau  sigma_eps        EZ        CI
